title: Assembly of the normalized derived projection data
statement: In the finite-field, l-invertible, finite-type setting of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], let S be a supplied coherent coefficient calculus [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], O the ordinary quotient projection, and H its constant-ring factorization [def-pur-sequence-adjoint-resolution-data]. Then PurSequenceDerivedAdjoints(l,E,W,S,O) is inhabited: its universal left and right derived comparisons have the specified strict K-flat and K-injective models; its adjunction comparisons preserve the supplied unit and counit; and for every simultaneous tower replacement its canonical replacement isomorphism and lim(j) composition equation hold. The geometric factorization is an input, and this assertion supplies only the derived data.

proof.text: Take L to be the supplied reduction and R to be the supplied total limit. Use A.reductionCounit as the left comparison. Define the right comparison as the ordinary limit identification, followed by eta and kappa. Transport its left Kan universal property along these natural isomorphisms.

proof.text: Use the supplied coefficient adjunction and identity left and right isomorphisms. The representative field of A gives the left model; invertibility of eta on K-injectives gives the right model. The comparison-transpose equation gives hom_normalization, and identities give both unit and counit fields.

theorem purSequenceDerivedNormalization
    (F : FiniteFieldDatum.{t}) (hl : l ≠ F.p)
    [W.Over (Spec (.of F.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (W ↘ Spec (.of F.k))] [QuasiCompact (W ↘ Spec (.of F.k))]
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E W)
    (hS : CoefficientDerivedSystemCoherence l E W S)
    (O : PurSequenceOrdinaryAdjoints l E W)
    (H : PurSequenceRingedFactorization l E W O) :
    Nonempty (PurSequenceDerivedAdjoints l E W S O)
